title: Tencent has released its AI model 'Hy4 preview,' which surpasses GPT-5.6 Sol in some tests, and has also released a 1-bit quantized version that is lighter at 213GB.
summary: Tencent has released its AI model 'Hy4 preview,' which surpasses GPT-5.6 Sol in some tests, and has also released a 1-bit quantized version that is lighter at 213GB. gigazine.net
body: Tencent has released its AI model 'Hy4 preview,' which surpasses GPT-5.6 Sol in some tests, and has also released a 1-bit quantized version that is lighter at 213GB. GIGAZINE
summaryZh: 腾讯正式发布了名为“Hy4 preview”的AI模型，据称在多项测试中超越了GPT-5.6 Sol模型。该模型不仅在性能上有所突破，还同步推出了1-bit量化版本，模型体积压缩至213GB，显著降低了部署门槛。此次发布展示了腾讯在超大规模模型优化与高效推理方面的最新进展，对于大模型在资源受限环境下的落地应用具有重要的参考价值，标志着量化技术在高性能模型中的进一步普及。

aiReview.reasonZh: 腾讯发布了声称超越行业标杆的新模型，并引入了1-bit量化技术，具有显著的技术指标意义。

指代文中提到的Hy4 preview等大规模人工智能模型。
